name: eskais-ui
description: UI SDK-first, agent-native React components distributed as a shadcn-style registry.

scripts.registry:build: bun tooling/sync-theme.ts && bun tooling/sync-mockup-version.ts && shadcn build
scripts.version: bun run registry:build && git add packages/mockup/src/version.ts public/r
scripts.test:browser:checks: bun run build:showcase && node tooling/overlay-check.mjs && node tooling/dialog-mobile-check.mjs --quick && node tooling/fast-link-check.mjs && node tooling/icon-tooltip-check.mjs && node tooling/shell-check.mjs && node tooling/touch-check.mjs && node tooling/calendar-check.mjs && node tooling/press-check.mjs && node tooling/popover-check.mjs && node tooling/color-picker-check.mjs && node tooling/image-scan-check.mjs && node tooling/model-check.mjs && node tooling/agent-bridge-check.mjs && node tooling/sortable-check.mjs && node tooling/tree-focus-check.mjs && node tooling/git-view-check.mjs && node tooling/markdown-check.mjs && node tooling/document-workspace-check.mjs && node tooling/find-check.mjs && node tooling/server-data-check.mjs && node tooling/conversation-check.mjs && node tooling/voice-input-check.mjs && node tooling/contrast-check.mjs && node tooling/contrast-check.mjs default --palettes=blue,violet,green,orange && node tooling/diff-bench.mjs --ci
scripts.test:browser:glass: bun run build:showcase && node tooling/contrast-check.mjs glass
scripts.test:compiler: REACT_COMPILER=1 bun run build:showcase && node tooling/overlay-check.mjs && node tooling/fast-link-check.mjs && node tooling/icon-tooltip-check.mjs && node tooling/shell-check.mjs && node tooling/touch-check.mjs && node tooling/calendar-check.mjs && node tooling/popover-check.mjs && node tooling/color-picker-check.mjs && node tooling/image-scan-check.mjs && node tooling/model-check.mjs && node tooling/agent-bridge-check.mjs && node tooling/sortable-check.mjs && node tooling/tree-focus-check.mjs && node tooling/git-view-check.mjs && node tooling/markdown-check.mjs && node tooling/document-workspace-check.mjs && node tooling/server-data-check.mjs && node tooling/find-check.mjs && node tooling/conversation-check.mjs && node tooling/voice-input-check.mjs && node tooling/contrast-check.mjs
scripts.screenshots: bun run build:showcase && node tooling/screenshots.mjs screenshots
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run registry:build
